name: robots/jerrypeng0201__nebula
title: NEBULA SceneManipulation-v1 (Fetch manipulation scene)
intro: NEBULA SceneManipulation-v1 (Fetch manipulation scene), adapted from jerrypeng0201/nebula. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
